conformance_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-A - Builderr Simulator Contract Conformance

conformance_evaluation.local_preview_behavior: Evaluates decide(market_state, portfolio_state, cash) at close of session T using bars through session T.
conformance_evaluation.host_engine_behavior: Invokes agent decide() post-market close of day T with daily bars up to day T.
conformance_evaluation.reconciliation: PERFECT_PARITY. Neither environment grants access to session T+1 data prior to decision generation.

conformance_evaluation.local_preview_behavior: Simulates execution at session T+1 Open prices.
conformance_evaluation.host_engine_behavior: Matches submitted orders at the official market open of session T+1.
conformance_evaluation.reconciliation: PERFECT_PARITY. All orders generated on day T close execute against day T+1 open prices.

conformance_evaluation.local_preview_behavior: Historically iterated through orders in the raw sequence returned by decide(). If buy orders were emitted before sell orders, buys could fail cash checks before sells were processed.
conformance_evaluation.host_engine_behavior: Host matching engine batches and executes all SELL orders first across the portfolio, then processes BUY orders.
conformance_evaluation.reconciliation: AUTHORITATIVE_HOST_POLICY_ADOPTED. Guardian Alpha's execution harness and causal event engine explicitly sort raw emitted orders to guarantee all sells execute before buys, releasing liquidity and achieving exact conformance with host matching mechanics.

conformance_evaluation.local_preview_behavior: Proceeds from morning sells are immediately credited to available cash within the same daily rebalance batch.
conformance_evaluation.host_engine_behavior: Proceeds from market-open sells are credited to buying power instantaneously for market-open buys.
conformance_evaluation.reconciliation: PERFECT_PARITY. T+0 intra-rebalance liquidity reuse is universally supported.

conformance_evaluation.local_preview_behavior: If buy orders exceed cash, preview either truncates buy quantities or rejects orders exceeding cash.
conformance_evaluation.host_engine_behavior: Host checks pre-trade buying power; if an order exceeds available settled cash, it is clamped to affordable integer shares or rejected with zero margin extension.
conformance_evaluation.reconciliation: PERFECT_PARITY. Both E0 and D2 employ the strict cash affordability clamp: affordable_shares = floor((cash - 10.0) / (open_price * (1 + fee + slippage))), guaranteeing zero negative cash.

conformance_evaluation.local_preview_behavior: Fractional share orders were tolerated in older preview scripts but flagged as non-standard.
conformance_evaluation.host_engine_behavior: Strict whole-share execution only (integer share quantities).
conformance_evaluation.reconciliation: PERFECT_PARITY. Both E0 and D2 explicitly floor all target position share calculations to positive integers (int(math.floor(target_shares))).

conformance_evaluation.local_preview_behavior: 5.0 basis points (0.05%) for standard equities/ETFs; 10.0 basis points (0.10%) for 2x/3x leveraged ETFs (QLD, SSO).
conformance_evaluation.host_engine_behavior: 5.0 bps standard equity / 10.0 bps leveraged ETFs.
conformance_evaluation.reconciliation: PERFECT_PARITY. Modeled identically across all research engines and tests.

conformance_evaluation.local_preview_behavior: 0.0 bps ($0.00 / trade) representing zero-commission broker model.
Peak concentration monitored <= 30.0% of portfolio equity; max 5 consecutive days breach permitted before disqualification.
conformance_evaluation.host_engine_behavior: Hard disqualification if single-name concentration exceeds 30.0% for > 5 consecutive trading days.
conformance_evaluation.reconciliation: PERFECT_PARITY. Max target weight in E0 and D2 is capped at 16.0% per single equity and 24.0% per defensive sector ETF, far below the 30.0% cap.

conformance_evaluation.local_preview_behavior: Gross exposure monitored <= 1.50x; preview computes both gross notional sum(|V|)/equity and beta-weighted sum(|V|*beta)/equity.
conformance_evaluation.host_engine_behavior: Maximum gross leverage cap is 1.50x. Borrowing on margin (gross > 1.00x unborrowed cash) is forbidden.
conformance_evaluation.reconciliation: PERFECT_PARITY. Risk-on gross notional exposure is exactly 0.94x (76% stocks + 18% leveraged ETFs + 6% cash); beta-adjusted exposure is 1.12x. Risk-off gross notional is 0.80x (E0) and 0.50x (D2). All configurations operate safely below 1.50x.

parity_audit_conclusion.strategy_parity_proof: Both Frozen E0 and Frozen D2 utilize the exact same order construction, sell-first sorting, integer share flooring, and cash affordability clamp.
